scope: unmerged fourth ordered FreeCAD development default C++ importer patch; bounded POLYFACE geometry
base: FreeCAD d956ec561639cfa83f755504b1b3358ea799428e with the three prior default-importer patches applied
nativeBuild: Headless macOS ARM64 FreeCADCmd built from exact source archive 29bdfe30632e084c0b6d015a1258f0ff75b8ed84fca660cec4e74fd4e2604bb9, AppleClang 21, Qt 6.12, OCCT 7.9.3; prior three patches applied
change: Import a conservative layer-0, unstyled POLYFACE profile as a Part compound of planar WCS triangles/quads. Collect coordinate and face records independently, allowing interleaving; validate finite coordinates, integer indices, owner and unique handles, supported subclasses, SEQEND and bounded record count before constructing any output. Refuse hidden edges, per-face styling, invalid metadata/indices, nonplanar or invalid faces and incomplete profiles; report them via FreeCAD unsupported-feature statistics. Continue to refuse polygon meshes.

validation.baseline: The previous guarded importer rejects generated POLYFACE and fails the proposed regression; the candidate imports the bounded profile.
validation.generatedTest: 26 named generated-DXF profiles: six accepted, 20 refused; covers triangle/quad, interleaved records, two triangles, canonical owner spelling, duplicate/invalid handles, bad ownership, invalid and hidden indices, style, subclass, nonplanar and partial-facet failure, and missing/bad SEQEND. Every case checks the following LINE. A separate same-file test verifies invalid mesh then valid mesh and LINE, with no partial geometry.
validation.nested: Independent ezdxf-generated two-triangle controls, in inches and millimetres, match analytic WCS outer-link vertices and area after two rotated nested INSERTs.
validation.combined: All six assembled FreeCAD regression tests pass for DIMENSION OCS axes, SOLID OCS, planar 3DFACE, classic polyline compatibility, bounded POLYFACE and same-file recovery. Four ordered patches apply to the exact base source; the built importer matches the assembled source.

limits: Four downstream FreeCAD default-importer patches are unmerged; native checks use headless Import.readDXF into fresh documents, not full GUI open/insert or Linux/Windows.

This is geometric import only; source DXF handles and editable mesh topology are not preserved as an output graph. Per-face styling, invisible edges, nonplanar faces, custom layers, unsupported metadata and polygon meshes remain explicitly refused.
No arbitrary nested transforms, binary DXF, physical producer sample, allocation-fault injection, producer/native semantic equivalence or phase-wide coverage is established.
Scratch fixture files are not committed and no format-support or phase-gate claim is promoted.
